Name: SwordFlightMod
Author: shenminglu
Description:
Sword Flight lets you travel Stardew Valley the xianxia way — standing on a floating Galaxy Sword instead of walking the usual walk cycle.

github: https://github.com/shenminglu196/sword-flight-mod

As you move, a directional blade appears under your feet with a soft elongated shadow. You and the sword bob gently together, and a cyan-to-violet light trail streams behind you. While flying, walk/run leg animations are replaced with a standing pose facing your current direction, so it feels like true sword flight rather than standing on a prop.

By default your speed matches vanilla. Raise the Move Speed multiplier in config if you want to fly faster. Soft collision while flying lets you pass water, terrain blockers, crops, NPCs, and monsters, while buildings and map edges stay solid so you stay on the map. The sword and effects hide automatically when you mount a horse, warp between locations, or during screen fades.

=== Main Features ===

• Floating Galaxy Sword under the player, with shadow and light trail
• Sword rotates with facing direction (up / down / left / right)
• Gentle floating bob while flying
• Standing pose instead of walk/run animation during flight
• Configurable flight move-speed multiplier (default 1.0 = vanilla)
• Soft noclip: pass soft obstacles; buildings and map borders still block
• Auto-hide while mounted, warping, or during fade transitions
• Optional in-game config via Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)

=== Requirements ===

• Stardew Valley 1.6+
• SMAPI 4.0+
• Generic Mod Config Menu (optional, for in-game settings)

=== How to Get Started ===

1. Install the latest SMAPI.
2. Download this mod and unzip it into your Stardew Valley Mods folder
  (e.g. .../Stardew Valley/Mods/SwordFlightMod).
3. (Optional) Install Generic Mod Config Menu for an in-game options menu.
4. Tweaks:
  • With GMCM: open the config menu from the title/options screen and adjust Enabled / Move Speed.
  • Without GMCM: edit Mods/SwordFlightMod/config.json
    - Enabled (true/false)
    - MoveSpeed (e.g. 1.0 = vanilla, higher = faster; roughly 0.1–10.0)

=== Notes ===

• Local player only — the flight visuals apply to you, not other farmers in multiplayer (as currently designed).
• Soft noclip is intentional for flight feel; walls/buildings/map edges still stop you.
• Compatible with the usual SMAPI mod setup; report issues with your SMAPI log if something looks wrong.

Sword Flight（御剑飞行）让你在星露谷物语里「御剑而行」：移动时站在一把浮动的银河剑上，而不是普通的走路/跑步姿态。

github: https://github.com/shenminglu196/sword-flight-mod

移动时，脚下会出现随朝向旋转的飞剑和细长阴影，人与剑一起轻微上下悬浮，身后拖出青紫相间的遁光尾迹。飞行中会取消走路/跑步腿部动画，改为面向当前方向的站立姿势，更像真正的御剑飞行。

默认移动速度与原版一致；可在配置中提高倍率，飞得更快。飞行时采用软穿障：可穿过水面、地形障碍、作物、NPC、怪物等，但建筑与地图边界仍会阻挡，避免飞出地图。骑马、过图或黑屏过渡时会自动收起飞剑与特效。

=== 主要功能 ===

• 脚下浮动银河剑，带阴影与遁光尾迹
• 飞剑随上下左右朝向旋转
• 飞行时轻微上下悬浮
• 飞行中保持站立姿势（无走路/跑步腿部动画）
• 可配置飞行移动速度倍率（默认 1.0 = 原版速度）
• 软穿障：穿过软障碍；建筑与地图边界仍阻挡
• 骑马、过图、黑屏过渡时自动隐藏
• 可选支持 Generic Mod Config Menu（GMCM）游戏内配置

=== 运行环境 ===

• 星露谷物语 1.6+
• SMAPI 4.0+
• Generic Mod Config Menu（可选，用于游戏内调设置）

=== 安装与开始 ===

1. 安装最新版 SMAPI。
2. 下载本 Mod，解压到游戏 Mods 文件夹
  （例如 .../Stardew Valley/Mods/SwordFlightMod）。
3. （可选）安装 Generic Mod Config Menu，方便在游戏内改设置。
4. 调整设置：
  • 有 GMCM：在标题/选项界面打开配置菜单，调整「启用 Mod」与「移动速度」。
  • 无 GMCM：编辑 Mods/SwordFlightMod/config.json
    - Enabled（true/false）
    - MoveSpeed（如 1.0 = 原版，更大更快；大约 0.1–10.0）

=== 其他说明 ===

• 目前效果主要针对本地玩家。
• 软穿障是为了御剑手感；建筑与地图边界仍会挡住你。
• 若出现异常，请附上 SMAPI 日志反馈。
